newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae puts $1 bln equity in taxcredit housing.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae puts $1 bln equity in taxcredit housing.

text.p: Fannie Mae said Wednesday that it will begin the second half of 1997 with $1 billion of equity investments in affordable multifamily housing that utilizes the federal low-income housing tax credit.
Fannie Mae said investments using the low-income housing tax credit provided the equity for more than 90 percent of all the low-income units constructed in 1995.
Properties that qualify for the credit are restricted to people with incomes of 60 percent or less of the area median income.
